affected_predicate.description: The user is successfully authenticated in TaoDian so the cart and checkout flow can proceed.

competing_trace_defects.description: The agent knowingly entered the placeholder code 123456 instead of the received SMS code; a subsequent login attempt visibly produced a verification-code error.

chains.rationale: At step 10, the reused history falsely stated that SMS login was complete while the login form remained visible, and the target retained that premise while repeating the login-button click. The false-completion premise persisted through the checkbox correction and another login attempt, but step 13 explicitly recognized the displayed verification-code error and acknowledged that authentication had failed, interrupting and correcting that mechanism. A new code was later sent, but no successful authentication was visibly established before the final observable step.

summary: The reuse target preserved the false premise that SMS authentication was complete and repeated the login action. That premise was later explicitly corrected after the verification-code error appeared, but successful authentication was never visibly established; entering the placeholder code 123456 was an independently observable competing defect.
